title: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy medically cleared from gunshot wound, but return still TBD

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy medically cleared from gunshot wound, but return still TBD
sources.description: Missouri running back Ahmad Hardy is medically cleared from a gunshot wound to the leg, but coach Eli Drinkwitz said Monday that a timetable for Hardy's return remains uncertain.
